TextBlock.Text: ARAFURA SEA, first light. HOBART is covering a convoy across the top of the Gulf and can hold an air picture out to about her own horizon. The surface group that matters is somewhere north of that line. SENTRY 06 is your Triton, launched from Tindal, and it is the only thing that can find them before they are inside missile range. It is unarmed, it is slow, and a pair of J-16s has come south off the enclave field on a vector that only makes sense if they know where the orbit is. Classify that surface group and it stays on your plot for the rest of the morning. To do it the Triton has to go north, into the part of the sky the J-16s own. Hold her south and she lives, and HOBART fights on her own horizon. Two Tindal F-35As are your entire air cover. You can spend them protecting the orbit or holding close escort on the convoy. You cannot do both, and whatever you lose today you do not have tomorrow. If the group is classified, expect the picture to raise a question it does not answer, and expect it while the Triton is still north.

Convoy: The convoy reaches its passage window Picture: Classify the northern surface group Sentry: Keep the Triton flying Hobart: Hobart survives Airlift: Identify the transport running into the enclave
HMAS Hobart, two RAAF F-35A off Tindal, one MQ-4C Triton, a Wedgetail on a long orbit. Opposing: two J-16, a Y-20 shuttling into the enclave, and a surface group not yet located.
60 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.

RAAF F-35A Lighting II, [DEPRECATED] E-7A Wedgetail, Auxilliary Merchant Pack, RE-power: the resupply mod, Merchants Expanded, J-16 Multirole Fighter, Y-20 / KJ-3000, Chinese Navy (PLAN), Modern PLAN Systems, this pack.
